Messages.Author: SF
Messages.Body:
i would like to suggest that a panel of international judges should be used
at the ec in france. seeing the recent differences in play style and
philosophy between france and the rest of europe i think this would weaken
the fears about unfair rulings.

stefan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


I believe the head judge at the EC will represent V:EKN and WW more than
adequately.

The fears some players have formed based on unofficial posts about certain
players' play style (not necessarily a whole country's play style) are a
separate issue.

If the players making such unofficial posts as if they were official would
kindly stop, that would be a great help in keeping these rumors and the fears
they cause at bay.

Besides, it's a little late in the game to try rewriting the V:EKN rules
to accomodate a panel of judges.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
SF wrote:
>
> if players from paris write that the price of paris is going to disencourage

Correction: "player" (singular).
And he's issued a correction, saying that his earlier post had been in error.

The prince of paris is not going to discourage legal play.

> table splitting deals than all players have the right to be coincerned that
> this ec is not going to be held by vekn rules. i still strongly suggest at
> least some international playing judges.

One cannot advocate breaking the V:EKN rules to ensure that they are not broken.

The only way to have playing judges is by using the multi-judge system, which
cannot be used if more than 20 players are playing. I hope that the EC has
more than 20 players.
